hypotheses.justification: Split on g = 0. In the nonzero case, use the existing proof. When g = 0, Place.ord_zero (Definitions/Def_AlgebraicCurve_DivisorClassGroup.lean) makes hD imply D = 0 by Finsupp extensionality, including when the place type is empty. Since lhs and rhs are additive homomorphisms, both send D = 0 to zero.
